About Event
​The Builder Base: Buildathon

​Your idea. Your stack. Your build.

​Welcome to The Builder Base: Buildathon — a one-day gathering in San Francisco for engineers, AI builders, founders, designers, and technology professionals who want to spend a full day turning ideas into working products.

​Builder Base is built around one simple idea: give builders the space, tools, people, and time to build.

​Whether you're experimenting with an AI agent, launching a developer tool, creating an enterprise workflow, building a data product, automating a painful process, or working on something completely unconventional, this is your base for the day.

​Come with an idea, a problem, a technology you want to explore — or nothing more than the desire to build. Find teammates, get feedback from experienced builders, learn from industry experts, and ship something you're proud of.

​Event Details

​When: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM, 30 October 2026
Where: San Francisco, CA
Format: One-day, in-person buildathon
Who: Engineers, AI Builders, Founders, Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, and Technology Professionals
Theme: Open-ended — Build what matters

​What to Expect

​A full day dedicated to building

​Turn an idea into a functional prototype

​Collaborate with engineers, founders, designers, and AI practitioners

​Meet potential teammates and future collaborators

​Mentorship and guidance from experienced industry professionals

​Access to modern AI tools, APIs, platforms, and developer resources

​Partner credits, challenges, and special prizes

​Live product demos and project showcases

​Networking with San Francisco's technology and startup community

​Food, refreshments, swag, and prizes

​What Can You Build?

​Anything worth building.

​Build an AI application, autonomous agent, developer tool, enterprise workflow, data platform, automation system, productivity tool, consumer product, infrastructure project, or an idea nobody has tried before.

​There are no prescribed problem statements and no requirement to build around a particular technology.

​Find a problem. Build the solution. Ship it.

​You can arrive with a fully formed idea or figure it out once you get there. The goal is to spend the day building, experimenting, learning, and turning an idea into something real.

​Who Should Join?

​The Builder Base is for people who make things.

​Whether you're an experienced software engineer, an AI developer exploring agentic systems, a founder testing a new idea, a product manager turning a concept into a prototype, a designer bringing an experience to life, or a student and early-career developer looking for your next challenge — you're welcome.

​You don't need to be an expert. You just need to be ready to build.

​Come with an idea. Leave with a build.

About Event

​AI is moving faster than most security programs can keep up with — agentic tools, MCP servers, and AI-generated code are shipping into production every day, often outrunning the guardrails meant to protect them. This hackathon brings developers and security practitioners together to get hands-on with the skills defining the new discipline of AI Security Engineering. Working in teams, participants will tackle real-world AI security challenges spanning securing MCP servers and agent skills against tool poisoning and supply-chain attacks, and hardening vibe-coded applications.

​Whether you're a developer curious about securing AI-powered apps or a security specialist looking to apply your skills to LLMs and agents, you'll leave with practical, portfolio-ready experience — and the kind of muscle memory that only comes from breaking (and fixing) real systems. No prior AI security experience required — just a builder's mindset and curiosity about where AI meets attack surface.

​Agenda

​9:30am: Doors open + Networking

​10:00 am - 10:30 am: Welcome + Agenda + Intros

​10:30 am -11:30 am: Introduction to AI Security Engineering

​11:30 am - 12:00 pm: Hackathon guidelines

​12:00 -12:30 pm: Lunch

​12:30 -1:30 pm: Hackathon

​1:30 pm: Submission deadline

​1:35 pm - 1:45: Judges evaluate submissions

​1:45 pm: Winners announced + Presentation

​2pm: Event ends

​Registration (IMPORTANT)

​Space is limited, please ensure you register both in Luma and on the following AWS URL http://events.builder.aws.com/d/vcz3j3 (required to enter the AWS building).
All guests must be 18+ and present a valid government-issued physical photo ID at check-in (digital IDs will not be accepted). Scooters and bikes are not permitted in any Amazon building with no on-site parking available.

​Sponsors
​​​​​Snyk

​Snyk is a developer-first cybersecurity platform that helps teams build fast without compromising on security. As developers rely heavily on AI to write code at unprecedented speeds, Snyk continuously scans and secures application code, open-source dependencies, containers, and cloud environments right within the developer’s workflow. For an AI hackathon, it matters because shipping code quickly with AI generators or autonomous agents also means shipping security risks at machine speed. Snyk acts as an intelligent security layer, catching vulnerabilities and automatically applying verified fixes in real time—allowing builders to ship ambitious AI projects safely and with complete confidence.
At this event you will learn:
1) Sign-up for free (no credit card required), how to import your code, and configure your AI coding tool
2) Free AI Security Engineer Foundations Certificate

​Prizes

​$10,000 in Anthropic credits, free stickers and cool swag from some of our sponsors upon completing some of the activities

Request to Join

About Event

At this event, you'll get a glimpse of the future of building with agents: together in the open.
We pack the room with founders, engineers, product leaders, hackers, designers, etc and we'll all work with agent teams to build something amazing. Agent teams do the heavy lifting on objectives (not prompts) while everyone in the room steers. Build Nights are like hackathons - but we're all on one big team. You'll leave with something you were part of making (hosted publicly), some new friends, and a totally refreshed outlook on building great products.

This event is absolutely free. You'll join the rest of the group on our community Party space where the tokens are free and you can see/steer everything that's cooking.
What you'll do:
We'll add you to the community Party space

Build, review, contribute to, and ship features to one shared project alongside others

Eat good food, drink good drink, meet other passionate builders

Enjoy the product you helped build

What to Expect
Schedule is approximate - the build runs as long as people want to keep going.
6:00 – 6:45 PM | Doors, Food & Networking Grab food and a drink, get your laptop set up, meet and greet.
6:45 – 7:00 PM | Welcome & Walkthrough What we're building, how Party works, and how to join the project.
7:00 – 8:30+ | Build Session

Who Should Attend
AI-pilled engineers curious what building in the open feels like

Product managers and designers who want to be more involved in the build

Founders and early startup teams looking to ship faster with better quality

Project managers and technical leads

Anyone who'd like to spend the evening building with like-minded individuals

What You'll Walk Away With
Something real that you helped build - that you’ll have access to after the event as well

The experience of building alongside others, with agents, to create something spectacular

Three months of Party Starter, free - which includes $20 in credits, monthly

$100 in credits so you can keep building

Important Details
Format: In person

What to bring: Your laptop

Experience level: All levels. Party, Cursor, Claude Code, etc experience not required.

Capacity: Limited seating. RSVP required.

Food & Drinks: Provided

Location: SoMa

About Party
Party is the multiplayer workspace where your whole team builds together alongside fleets of agents, out in the open. Agent Flows do the heavy lifting in secure sandboxes while humans steer. You pick the harness and model for each agent in the Flow - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Opencode - and work in the same session as the rest of your team. Bring your own keys, or use ours.

Google Docs made documents collaborative.
Figma made design collaborative.
Now, Party is making building collaborative.
Learn more about Party at party.build . Try Party at app.party.build (web, MacOS, iOS, and Android).
Sponsorship & Partners
Interested in getting involved? We work with partners on demos, speaking slots, and co-hosted nights. Reach out to Julian at julian@810hamilton.com

candidates.title: Universal Hackathon - Create Your Own AI Workforce | AWS Builder Loft
candidates.evidence:
Universal Hackathon - Create Your Own AI Workforce | AWS Builder Loft
The Universal Celebration Hackathon is a celebration of creativity, entrepreneurship, and the next generation of AI-powered companies. Bring your ideas, experiment with new possibilities, and turn your vision into something real.
This hackathon is about more than building a prototype. It’s about imagining what a company looks like when AI agents can work together as a team.
The Challenge
Build a company run by a team of AI agents.
Your challenge is to create an AI-native business or startup where multiple specialized agents work together to build, operate, and grow the company.
Think of your agents as your founding team. You might have a CEO agent defining strategy, a product agent building the product, engineering agents writing code, marketing agents finding customers, sales agents closing deals, finance agents managing the business, and operations or customer-support agents keeping everything running.
The key question is:
What happens when you give an AI team a business to run?

What to Build
Build a working prototype of a company powered by a team of collaborating AI agents.
Your project should:
Identify a real problem or opportunity.
Define a clear product, service, or business.
Create multiple AI agents with distinct roles and responsibilities.
Show how your agents communicate, collaborate, and make decisions.
Demonstrate how the agents can actually execute business tasks.
Show how your company could acquire customers, deliver value, and grow.
You can build for consumers, businesses, creators, communities, or any other audience.
Don’t just build an AI feature. Build the beginnings of an AI-native company.
Tracks
Choose one or multiple tracks and build your company within them.
Climate, Sustainability & Impact
Build AI solutions for a healthier planet and stronger communities.
Examples: climate, sustainability, agriculture, disaster response, smart cities, social impact.
Health, Wellness & Care
Build AI solutions that improve health, wellbeing, and quality of life.
Examples: healthcare, fitness, nutrition, mental wellness, elder care.
Education, Learning & Research
Build AI solutions that make learning, education, and research better.
Examples: tutoring, personalized learning, professional training, research, career development.
Business, Growth & Productivity
Build AI solutions that help businesses work smarter, grow faster, and operate better.
Examples: sales, marketing, CRM, analytics, productivity, automation, business operations.
Media, Entertainment & Creators
Build AI solutions for creativity, entertainment, and digital experiences.
Examples: film, music, gaming, content creation, creator tools, social media.
Commerce, Retail & Consumer
Build AI solutions that transform how people shop and how businesses sell.
Examples: e-commerce, marketplaces, retail, logistics, inventory, personalized shopping.
Build the Future
Whether you're creating a climate startup, an AI health company, an education platform, a new media studio, or an autonomous business operating system, the goal is the same:
Build a company where a team of AI agents can turn an idea into reality.
Come celebrate, build, experiment, and show us what the future of business looks like.

Your job is to use AI and a small autonomous car like the Donkeycar or equivalent (typically 1/16th scale or smaller RC car with a Raspberry Pi or equivalent and a camera controlling it) to navigate the "city", obeying signs and making it from one side to the other in the fastest time. 

You must bring your own car, which should be ready to run, with compute and camera already onboard and working. The objective of the hackathon is to add AI "city" navigation to it. 

You can use onboard AI, AI on your laptop via Wifi or AI in the cloud to help with the navigation. Think creatively about what kind of AI to use and what's the fastest way to do it!

This is not an event for spectators, nor will cars be provided to those who arrive without one. This is a hackathon, not a regular race. Come ready to hack!
